name: Orlivane Embroidery Kit for Beginners, Bird and Flower Pattern with Hoop
highlights: Pre-Printed Fabric, Colored Threads, Needles, 20 cm Imitation Bamboo Hoop, English Instructions, 5 Patterns
bullets: PATTERN PRINTED ON THE FABRIC — The design is printed on the cloth, so you simply stitch along the lines. A relaxing project for beginners.
EVERYTHING IN ONE KIT — Pre-printed fabric (about 30 x 30 cm), colored embroidery threads, needles, a 20 cm imitation bamboo hoop and English instructions.
5 BIRD AND FLOWER DESIGNS — Choose from five patterns with songbirds, blossoms and butterflies.
DISPLAY IN THE HOOP — When you finish, keep the work in the hoop and hang it on the wall or stand it on a shelf.
A THOUGHTFUL CRAFT GIFT — A calm handmade project for friends, mothers and anyone who wants to try embroidery.
desc: This Orlivane embroidery kit is made for beginners. The bird-and-flower design is pre-printed on cotton-linen fabric (about 30 x 30 cm), so you follow the print with the included colored threads and needles. The kit also includes a 20 cm imitation bamboo hoop and English instructions. Finished work can stay in the hoop for display. Five patterns available.
